old_problem: The historical review left the single-record delete entirely Pending because the Master does not select a target. IPMI 2.0 sections 33.8, 33.11, 33.12 and 33.15 define the exact reservation, volatile Record ID, stable-key revalidation, Delete request and returned-ID behavior. A safe target can be parameterized as a dedicated inert disposable fixture whose removal returns the repository to an independently captured pre-fixture baseline; no production sensor record or broad clear needs to be guessed.
disposition_reason: Use only one pre-provisioned, owner-approved disposable SDR that is absent from a pre-fixture canonical baseline and has no live sensor/control dependency. Export it completely, obtain a fresh 0Ah/22h reservation, use 0Ah/23h under that same reservation to revalidate the current RID, stable key and body immediately before deletion, obtain final confirmation, and send one 0Ah/26h request containing reservation LS/MS plus exact RID LS/MS. Require completion 00h and the same returned RID, then enumerate by stable key—not by the now-recyclable ID—to prove only the fixture disappeared and the canonical repository/monitoring state equals pre-fixture baseline. Unsupported is capability-backed N/A. Never target 0000h/FFFFh, a real sensor, a stale RID, multiple records, Clear SDR, automatic retry or OOB evidence.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1081-1087, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. tests.json contains one occurrence of this code. The related OOB Delete SDR is row 1213 / variant 50ee37b87ce7ce86 and remains separate. Formal queue sequence 77 was independently verified as row 1087 / variant 4bcd611f0fe7e11e.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Delete SDR to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 26h. Section 33.15 defines exactly four request bytes—Reservation ID LS/MS and Record ID LS/MS—and completion plus the deleted Record ID LS/MS in response.

Delete SDR is optional and Get SDR Repository Info operation-support bit 3 reports support. A read-only or Delete-unsupported repository is N/A only when authoritative target evidence agrees; a generic error without identity/capability evidence is not enough.

Section 33.11 requires a current reservation for Delete. A repository change that may move Record IDs cancels the reservation, causing a stale delete to fail instead of deleting a newly mapped record; reservation is a race detector, not a permanent lock or authorization by itself.

Section 33.8 states that Record IDs are handles that can be recycled or reassigned. The target must therefore be selected by stable record type/key/body and re-read under the same reservation immediately before 26h; never infer RID order or use 0000h/FFFFh selectors.

After deletion, the old RID may be reassigned to another record. Querying that RID and expecting an error is not a sufficient oracle; sequential enumeration must prove the exact stable key absent and every unrelated key/body present.

A disposable fixture makes destructive coverage safe and complete. It is provisioned under a separate approved setup, has a unique key and bounded/no monitoring effect, and is absent from PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE. Successful deletion therefore restores that baseline rather than removing a real platform definition.

Add/delete can legitimately reassign other Record IDs and update repository timestamps. Final reconciliation uses a canonical multiset of version/type/key/body plus count/capacity/overflow and monitoring state, not a false requirement that raw bytes including IDs/timestamps hash identically.

The exact exported fixture bytes also provide owner-controlled rebuild data if an unexpected record is affected. Re-add is an emergency owner action under its own reviewed Add/Partial Add path, never an automatic step that masks a failed Delete test.

ED-02 preserves identity; ED-03 protects OEM record meaning; ED-13/ED-15 govern N/A and criteria; ED-17 preserves exports/logs; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require recovery; ED-34 parameterizes the fixture; ED-38 prohibits retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Delete SDR (IB Storage 0Ah/26h) same-reservation identity check and disposable-record removal
test_case.purpose: Delete exactly one in-band disposable SDR record under a fresh reservation, prove the pre-delete RID still belongs to the approved stable key/body, verify no unrelated repository or monitoring coverage was lost, and return to the pre-fixture logical baseline without full clear or cross-crediting OOB/Clear SDR.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware/local interface with Get SDR Repository Info Delete-support bit and working 0Ah/22h, 23h and 26h commands

Dedicated inert DELETE_FIXTURE created by a separately approved setup: unique standard/OEM type/key/body, current RID, exact raw bytes, owner/IANA authority, dependency proof and expected no/bounded monitoring effect

Immutable PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE from before fixture provisioning and PREDELETE repository export, both canonicalized by version/type/stable-key/body while retaining raw records, IDs and timestamps as audit evidence

Fresh-reservation bounded Get SDR reader, exact Delete request builder, sequential post-delete enumerator and comparator for count/free space/erase timestamp/overflow plus sensor/inventory/alert/control state

Immediate record-specific confirmation, incident/retention clearance and owner-held recovery artifact able to reconstruct any unexpectedly affected record through a separately reviewed Add/Partial Add path
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED SINGLE-RECORD DELETE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant/target and 0Ah/20h Delete support; load immutable PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE and export the complete PREDELETE repository. Require exactly one DELETE_FIXTURE stable key, prove it is absent from PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE, inert or bounded by the approved effect oracle, not under retention/incident hold, and currently mapped to a non-selector RID (not 0000h/FFFFh). Compare all other canonical records to PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE. Obtain one fresh 0Ah/22h reservation R. Without acquiring another reservation, reconstruct the target with bounded 0Ah/23h reads using R and require exact fixture type/key/body/RID; abort on any cancellation or mismatch. Display R, RID, stable key, record hash, expected canonical post-state and recovery artifact for immediate confirmation. Send exactly once over `-I open`: `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x26 Rlo Rhi RIDlo RIDhi`. Require completion 00h and returned RID equal the request. Do not retry. Sequentially enumerate the repository from first to last, search by stable key, and require zero fixture matches; do not assume the old RID is now invalid. Require count one lower than PREDELETE and equal to PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE, coherent free-space/erase metadata, overflow unchanged, exact canonical PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE equality and expected monitoring/alert/control state. Keep row-1087 Clear and row-1213 OOB separate.
test_case.expected_result: The same-reservation precheck proves the selected RID maps to the one approved disposable key/body. The single 26h request completes 00h and returns that RID. Post-delete sequential enumeration contains no matching stable key, retains every unrelated canonical record, returns count and logical content to PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE, changes repository erase/capacity metadata coherently and causes only the approved monitoring effect. Record IDs and timestamps may legitimately differ. Unsupported Delete is evidence-backed N/A. Any identity race, wrong/multiple missing record, dependency loss or recovery divergence is FAIL/NOT READY without another delete.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact IB identity, authoritative Delete support, one dedicated disposable fixture and two-level baseline, a fresh reservation, complete same-reservation target re-read, immediate approval, one exact 26h request, matching returned RID, stable-key absence, all unrelated canonical records intact and pre-fixture monitoring recovery. FAIL covers a stale/unverified RID, 0000h/FFFFh, live/held record, command success without returned-ID and full enumeration, relying on old-RID failure, any unrelated loss/effect, Clear/OOB substitution, raw-hash-only comparison, automatic retry or unresolved recovery. NOT READY covers absent fixture, baseline, dependency proof, Delete capability, reader, approval or reconstruction artifact. N/A requires authoritative Delete-unsupported evidence.
safety_gate: Target only a dedicated disposable fixture with a unique stable key and no irreplaceable monitoring role. A production sensor, threshold, locator, association or unknown OEM record is never selected by this parameterized case.
Preserve complete raw PRE_FIXTURE and PREDELETE exports plus canonical comparisons. Do not clear SDR, SEL or OS logs and do not use the source boilerplate's clear step.

Acquire one fresh reservation and keep it unchanged from final 23h identity proof through 26h. Reservation cancellation, RID/key/body drift or any concurrent repository writer stops the test without retry.
Display exact RID and stable record hash for immediate approval. Never send 0000h, FFFFh, a wildcard, an incremented/decremented ID or a RID derived from prior runs.
Verify deletion by sequential stable-key enumeration and canonical content, not by assuming the old RID disappears. Other IDs may be reassigned legitimately.

No automatic retry or second delete. If completion is ambiguous, enumerate once and stop; if any unexpected key is missing, freeze repository writes and hand exact reconstruction to the owner—never clear/reset or improvise a re-add.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; official reservation/RID/26h authority and Delete capability; distinct Clear/OOB identities
Immutable PRE_FIXTURE and PREDELETE raw exports, canonical key/body multisets, repository info and monitoring/dependency/retention audit
Exact disposable fixture source/hash/type/key/body/current RID, OEM authority if applicable, uniqueness proof and reconstruction artifact
Fresh reservation, complete same-reservation 23h target reconstruction, displayed action and immediate confirmation
Exact 26h request/completion/returned RID followed by full sequential stable-key search, count/capacity/erase/overflow comparison
All unrelated canonical records and sensor/inventory/alert/control state preserved, final PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A and explicit statement that the review agent executed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: Because the selected fixture is absent from PRE_FIXTURE_BASELINE, a successful deletion is the planned restoration. If 26h completion is ambiguous, do not resend: enumerate once by stable key and compare the canonical repository. If the fixture remains, preserve it as inert failed-test state and hand cleanup to the owner; if it is absent and all else matches, record the ambiguous transport result rather than rerunning. If any unrelated record is missing or changed, stop every write, preserve raw exports and monitoring state, and let the owner reconstruct only the exact affected record through a separately authorized Add/Partial Add procedure. Never Clear SDR, reset, or automatically retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the reservation, request/response and volatile-ID semantics. The Review layer safely parameterizes one disposable target and replaces the generic log-clear/TBD body with stable-key verification and canonical reconciliation.

blocked.reason: A standard exact-one-record delete and race-safe identity method exist. Target selection, disposable fixture, dependency audit and recovery artifact are bounded Project prerequisites, not missing core operation semantics.

external_authorities.application: Sections 33.8 and 33.11-33.16 plus Appendix G define volatile/recyclable SDR Record IDs, reservation ownership/cancellation, Get SDR identity verification, optional Delete support and the exact Storage 0Ah/Cmd26h four-byte request and returned RID.

project_authority: The SDR/BMC owner provisions and identifies the disposable fixture, proves dependencies and retention status, supplies pre-fixture/pre-delete baselines, confirms Delete support, authorizes the exact RID and retains reconstruction material. It cannot authorize wildcard/stale IDs, live unknown records, Clear/OOB substitution, completion-only PASS, retry, or recovery that hides an unrelated deletion.
